what: Promoting the K-quant prefill owner from opt-in to default-on for win-x86_64. The owner is not new code -- it has been in the tree since 2026-07-08, is bit-identical by construction, and was parked in the STAMPEDE Phase 3 PIVOT band when it measured +50%. The lane has improved four times since that decision (Q6_K sibling, AVX-512 VNNI inner, 8-row repack, and the 256-bit AVX-VNNI inner merged as #593) and the flag was never revisited.
lever: RuntimeConfig::kquant_prefill_owner now resolves through env_flag_default_on for win-x86_64 and stays env_flag_default_off everywhere else. Kill switch: CAMELID_X86_KQUANT_MATMUL_OWNER=0|false|off|no|disabled.
why_now: The Phase 3 gate is written down in STAMPEDE_CONDUCTOR: prefill >= 28 tok/s -> GO, promote the owner to default; 24-28 -> PIVOT, keep it opt-in. Lane B (Q4_K) landed in the PIVOT band at v2 and stayed opt-in. Nothing re-checked the gate after the lane got faster four more times. This receipt re-checks it.

host.cpu: win i9-14900HX 8P+16E (24 physical / 32 logical), Raptor Lake
host.isa: avx2=true avxvnni=true; avx512f=false -- so the owner's selected inner here is the 256-bit AVX-VNNI one from #593
host.gpu: RTX 4060 Laptop present but hidden with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 for every measurement
host.power: AC for every reported number (BatteryStatus=2 recorded per run). An earlier screening pass on battery is excluded from this receipt.

method.baseline: off -- the question is owner vs the SHIPPED DEFAULT, not owner vs a different inner
method.pairing: all arms run once per round inside one process, interleaved, 2 warmup rounds discarded
method.statistic: median of per-round ratios, 95% percentile bootstrap CI (2000 resamples)
method.engagement_check: the sweep hard-fails a config whose owner never dispatched; owner_prefill_taken is recorded per row

results.note: owner_avxvnni256 is what a promoted default actually selects on this host. owner_avx2 is what it selects on an AVX2-only host, and is reported so the promotion is not justified purely by hardware this receipt's author happens to own.
results.avx2_only_hosts: owner_avx2 vs off spans 1.4102 to 1.6115 across the same nine cells, all significant, so the promotion is a win on plain-AVX2 hosts too and does not depend on AVX-VNNI.

the_regression_that_did_not_happen.why_it_was_the_deciding_test: The Q8 owner -- the same shape of lever, promoted the same way -- turns out to REGRESS on a 1B model (0.9730 vs off at 2421 tokens, 0/8 rounds; see stampede-p3-q8-owner-avxvnni256-14900hx-20260803.json). The K-quant owner had only ever been measured on 3B/4B, so the small-model case was the specific risk to this promotion.
the_regression_that_did_not_happen.result: Llama-3.2-1B Q4_K_M was pulled specifically to test it and shows the LARGEST wins of any model measured (1.8768 / 1.7488 / 1.5619). The failure mode does not reproduce on this lane.
the_regression_that_did_not_happen.contaminated_cell_rerun: qwen4b at 2421 tokens first returned an off arm spanning 10.18-24.12 tok/s and an owner_avxvnni256 CI of [0.6876, 1.9466] (not significant). It was re-run rather than reported: the clean re-run has off 23.58-24.11 and owner 37.29-37.56, giving 1.5700 [1.5465, 1.5821], 5/5. The contaminated cell is discarded, not averaged in.

cost.reading: Under 0.25% in both directions, i.e. inside run-to-run noise. The owner reuses a thread-local packed-input scratch; it is not the opt-in 8-row repack, which is a separate flag and stays off.
cost.decode: untouched -- the owner is prefill-only and declines batches below 4 rows.

parity.e2e_hash_equality: byte-identical generated text with the owner off vs on, per model: llama1b e07ef0c0bea3e982, llama3b 788682831fb9ada1, qwen3-4b f5f70dae91dd9706

promotion_proof_on_the_shipped_binary.note: Three arms on the built binary: no env var (the promoted default), the kill switch, and explicit opt-in. One SHA per model across all three.

parity.why_it_is_exact: The owner was built bit-identical by construction and has carried twin tests against the per-cell block-dot path since it landed; this change adds no arithmetic, it selects an existing path.

blast_radius.scope: win-x86_64 only, matching the platform measured here and mirroring how the Q8 owner's default-on scope was set. Every other target keeps env_flag_default_off, so nothing changes for them.
blast_radius.kill_switch: CAMELID_X86_KQUANT_MATMUL_OWNER=0|false|off|no|disabled restores the previous path exactly -- verified on the shipped binary, and the timings return to the pre-promotion values.
blast_radius.typo_safety: any OTHER value leaves the owner on, so a mistyped kill switch cannot silently disable a measured default. Same convention as CAMELID_WIN_HYBRID_POLICY.
blast_radius.repack8: unchanged and still opt-in; it is a separate flag with a memory cost.

test_suite_state: cargo test --lib: 1463 passed / 2 failed. Both failures (api::engine::tests::slot_occupancy_tracks_cooperative_and_exclusive_work, api::tests::cooperative_stream_job_seeds_from_the_prompt_prefix_cache) were re-proved pre-existing at 77b054dd2 by stashing this branch's src changes and rerunning on the clean tree. Neither is in the inference path.
open_questions: One host. The promotion is scoped to win-x86_64 but measured on a single hybrid Raptor Lake part; an AVX2-only or AMD x86 host would strengthen or narrow the scope.
Q4_K_M only. Q5_K_M, Q3_K_M, Q2_K and IQ4_XS route through the same owner gate but were not swept -- several of them have no SIMD kernel at all, so the owner's benefit there is unmeasured.
The Q8 owner's 1B regression remains open and is NOT addressed here; the two owners are separate flags with separate defaults.

The gate in STAMPEDE_CONDUCTOR is expressed as an absolute tok/s against a llama.cpp pin on an i7-11800H. This receipt argues the promotion on measured ratio-vs-shipped-default plus zero regression instead, because the pinned reference was not re-run on this host.
verdict: Promote for win-x86_64. 9 of 9 cells significant, 66 of 66 paired rounds, 1.56x to 1.88x over the shipped default across three models and three prompt lengths, byte-identical output, no measurable memory cost, and a verified kill switch. The small-model regression that sank the equivalent Q8 claim was specifically tested for and does not occur.
